name: c4_long_chat
spec: SPEC §16.2 C4: a long chat (25 caller turns, the context size of a 10+ minute call); latency over the last 10 turns stays within §12.1 (projected: LLM stage + the §12.2 500 ms non-LLM budget). On a real phone, pace it over 10 minutes and read the turns timings instead.

turns.say: Hello dear, I just wanted some company this afternoon.
It's a grey day here. I've been sitting by the window with my tea.
I was thinking about when Dana was little. She used to love the swings at the park.
Oh, she'd go higher and higher, and I'd be so nervous!
Her father used to push her. He passed away six years ago now.
Thank you. He was a good man. He loved gardening, like me.
This year I'm growing tomatoes and a little basil.
The basil is doing better than the tomatoes, to be honest.
Do you know any tricks for tomatoes when it's been so rainy?
That's helpful. I'll try that when it dries out.
Lily has her piano lessons on Thursdays. She's getting quite good.
She played a bit of Chopin for me last time she visited.
I used to play too, a long time ago. My hands aren't what they were.
Maybe I'll try again. My doctor says it's good for the hands.
I watched a cooking show this morning. They made a lemon cake.
I used to bake every Sunday. Dana's favorite was banana bread.
Perhaps I'll make some when she visits next.
Tyler is coming home from college for the holidays, too.
He's studying engineering. Very clever boy.
He calls me on Sundays, usually. Such a sweet boy.
Do you think it will rain again tomorrow?
Well, I'll keep my umbrella handy then.
I've enjoyed our chat. It makes the afternoon go faster.
You're very kind. I think I'll make another cup of tea.
Thank you, dear. Goodbye for now.
